# SwiftLaTeX browser engine assets

Vendored from:

https://github.com/SwiftLaTeX/SwiftLaTeX/releases/tag/v20022022

These files provide the PdfTeX WebAssembly runtime used by Undertwig to compile
LaTeX locally in the browser.
